parameters.name: HttpPorts
parameters.description: The HTTP ports that are supported. Set this parameter to a string. Specify multiple ports in the **port1,port2,port3** format.

parameters.name: HttpsPorts
parameters.description: The HTTPS ports that are supported. Set this parameter to a string. Specify multiple ports in the **port1,port2,port3** format.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: ProtectionServerCount
parameters.description: The number of protection nodes that can be added to the cluster.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the WAF instance. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
